name: Death Game wa Hajimaranai
original_name: デスゲームは始まらない
source:
──The death game is over before it starts (in earnest).

As a mediocre college student, you were in a strange place when you woke up.
Your body is tied to a chair, and even handcuffs and shackles are attached.
What on earth is it for me ...?
The old TV in front of me shows a strange appearance.
this is……! ??

A "non-starting" death game comedy with the Ponkotsu moderator is about to begin!!!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5438]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
——死亡游戏，还没正式开始，就已经结束了。

身为平凡大学生的你，一觉醒来，却发现自己身处陌生的地方。
身体被绑在椅子上，还戴着手铐和脚镣。
自己究竟遭遇了什么…？
眼前的老旧电视里，出现了一个古怪的身影。
这是……？！

与废柴主持人一同上演的“始终无法开始”的死亡游戏喜剧，即将开场！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5438]NovelGame[/url]]
